title: Near-atomic cryo-EM structures of small proteins without scaffolds

concept.text: Determine three-dimensional structures of small, unbound proteins by single-particle cryo-EM, below the roughly 50–70 kDa range where particles become too low in contrast to align. Proposed completion test: single-particle cryo-EM structures at 3 Å or finer (gold-standard FSC 0.143) of monomeric proteins of 20 kDa or less, with no fiducial scaffold, binder, fusion or symmetric assembly adding mass, reproduced on several unrelated targets and by an independent group. Test set by: no outside body sets it; the 3 Å and 20 kDa thresholds are editorial, near myoglobin (17 kDa), the target the laser phase plate developers name. Overlaps: CRX-01. Sources given: [UC Berkeley news, 11 June 2026](https://news.berkeley.edu/2026/06/11/a-breakthrough-in-electron-microscopy-delivers-sharper-images-of-our-bodys-tiniest-proteins/).
